tasks.description: Build a transactional event-sourced inventory engine with concurrency, idempotency, replay, and tamper detection

results.description: Build a transactional event-sourced inventory engine with concurrency, idempotency, replay, and tamper detection

metrics.finalText:
Implemented complete production-quality event-sourced inventory engine:

**Files created:** src/errors.ts, src/types.ts, src/store.ts, src/engine.ts, src/index.ts, test/inventory.test.ts, finish_notes.md

**Results:** 61/61 tests pass, typecheck clean, zero errors.

**Key features:**
- Exact idempotency with commandId deduplication
- Atomic multi-SKU batch with full rollback on failure
- Optimistic concurrency with ConcurrencyError
- Deep immutability of all returned values
- Deterministic hash-chained JSONL (SHA-256)
- Rigorous replay validation
- Continuation after restore
